product_overview: Tony ERP is a full-featured, Arabic-first ERP platform for mattress factories and SMEs covering accounting, inventory, production, sales/POS, HR and REST APIs. It provides unified processes, RBAC, JWT authentication, background tasks (Celery) and comprehensive reporting.
core_goals: Provide a single integrated ERP covering accounting, inventory, production, sales/POS and HR tailored for mattress/manufacturing businesses.
Expose a REST API for integrations and automation while preserving a polished RTL web UI for daily operations.
Ensure security and compliance with JWT/session authentication, 2FA, audit logging and ZATCA electronic invoicing support.
Automate accounting and inventory updates from operational transactions (sales, purchases, production).
Deliver reliable production workflows (BOM → production orders → inventory updates) and real-time system health endpoints.

features.name: Authentication & JWT
features.description: User authentication via JWT (access + refresh), token verification and session-based login/logout pages for web UI.
user_flows: POST /api/token/ with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with {access, refresh} -> POST /api/token/refresh/ with refresh token -> Receive 200 with {access} -> POST /api/token/verify/ with access token -> Receive 200 {}
POST /api/token/ with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 Invalid credentials -> POST /api/token/verify/ with tampered token -> Receive 401 Token is invalid
GET /accounts/login/ -> Receive 200 HTML login page -> GET /accounts/logout/ with active session -> Receive 302 Redirect to login

features.name: Production Management (Mattress Factory)
features.description: Manage Bill of Materials (BOM), create and run production orders through states (Pending -> In Progress -> Completed) with inventory updates.
user_flows: POST /api/token/ with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with {access, refresh} -> GET /production/api/bom/ with access token -> Receive 200 BillOfMaterials[] -> POST /production/orders/create/ with body {bom: <id>, quantity: <n>} -> Receive 302 Redirect to order detail -> POST /production/orders/{id}/start/ -> Receive 302 Redirect -> POST /production/orders/{id}/complete/ -> Receive 302 Redirect and inventory updated

POST /api/token/ with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with {access, refresh} -> POST /production/orders/create/ with invalid body (missing bom) -> Receive 400 Validation error -> GET /production/api/orders/ with access token -> Receive 200 ProductionOrder[]

features.name: Sales & Invoicing
features.description: Create quotations and sales invoices, post invoices to create accounting entries, handle returns and VAT-compliant e-invoicing.
user_flows: POST /api/token/ with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with {access, refresh} -> POST /sales/invoices/create/ with body {customer: <id>, items: [...] , status: 'draft'} -> Receive 302 Redirect to invoice detail -> GET /sales/invoices/{id}/ with session/token -> Receive 200 HTML detail -> POST /sales/invoices/{id}/post/ -> Receive 302 Redirect (creates accounting entry)
POST /api/token/ with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with {access, refresh} -> POST /sales/invoices/create/ with missing items -> Receive 400 Validation error

features.name: POS (Point of Sale)
features.description: Full-screen POS terminal for walk-in sales supporting barcode/product search, multiple payment methods and receipt printing.
user_flows: POST /api/token/ with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with {access, refresh} -> GET /pos/terminal/ with session or token -> Receive 200 HTML POS interface -> POST /pos/sale/ with body {items: [...], payment_method: 'cash'} -> Receive 200 Sale confirmation
POST /pos/sale/ without authentication -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Accounting
features.description: Full chart of accounts, manual and automatic journal entries, trial balance and financial reports with validation (debits = credits).
user_flows: POST /api/token/ with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with {access, refresh} -> GET /accounting/ with token -> Receive 200 HTML dashboard -> POST /accounting/journal-entries/create/ with body {date, description, lines: [{account, debit, credit}, ...]} balanced -> Receive 302 Redirect -> GET /accounting/trial-balance/ -> Receive 200 HTML report
POST /api/token/ with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with {access, refresh} -> POST /accounting/journal-entries/create/ with lines where debit != credit -> Receive 400 Debit != Credit

features.name: Inventory Management
features.description: Manage products, warehouses, stock levels, transfers, adjustments and product search with alerts for low stock.
user_flows: POST /api/token/ with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with {access, refresh} -> GET /inventory/products/create/ with token -> Receive 200 HTML form -> POST /inventory/products/create/ with body {name, sku, price, category} -> Receive 302 Redirect -> GET /inventory/products/ -> Receive 200 HTML list

POST /api/products/ (REST) with invalid price (e.g., negative) and access token -> Receive 400 Validation error -> GET /inventory/search/?q=unknown with token -> Receive 200 HTML search results (possibly empty)

features.name: HR & Payroll
features.description: Employee records, attendance tracking and payroll generation with payslip batching and accounting entries.
user_flows: POST /api/token/ with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with {access, refresh} -> POST /hr/employees/create/ with body {name, department, salary} -> Receive 302 Redirect -> POST /hr/payslips/generate/ with body {period, employees: [...] } -> Receive 302 Redirect -> GET /hr/payslips/ -> Receive 200 HTML list
POST /api/token/ with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with {access, refresh} -> POST /hr/employees/create/ with missing salary -> Receive 400 Validation error

features.name: REST API (Core)
features.description: DRF-based API for managing products, customers, invoices and stock for integrations and automated workflows.
user_flows: POST /api/token/ with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with {access, refresh} -> POST /api/products/ with body {name, sku, price} and Authorization Bearer -> Receive 201 Product -> GET /api/stock/ with Authorization Bearer -> Receive 200 Stock[] -> POST /api/invoices/ with body {customer: <id>, items: [...]} -> Receive 201 Invoice
POST /api/invoices/ with non-existent customer id and Authorization Bearer -> Receive 400 Validation error -> GET /api/customers/ with Authorization Bearer -> Receive 200 Customer[]

features.name: Quick Access Dashboard
features.description: Unified quick-access dashboard with global search, shortcuts and bulk actions for power users.
user_flows: POST /api/token/ with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with {access, refresh} -> GET /quick/ with token -> Receive 200 HTML dashboard -> GET /quick/search/?q=widget with token -> Receive 200 HTML search results
GET /quick/ without authentication -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> GET /quick/search/?q= without authentication -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: System Health
features.description: Liveness/readiness probes and diagnostic UI for monitoring and deployment checks.
user_flows: GET /health/live/ -> Receive 200 {"status":"ok"} -> GET /health/ready/ -> Receive 200 {"status":"ready"} -> POST /api/token/ with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with {access, refresh} -> GET /diagnostic/ with token -> Receive 200 HTML diagnostics
GET /diagnostic/ without authentication -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> POST /api/token/refresh/ with invalid refresh token -> Receive 401

features.name: User & Role Management (RBAC)
features.description: User CRUD and role/permission APIs supporting owner/GM/admin/staff roles and RBAC enforcement across modules.
user_flows: POST /api/token/ with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with {access, refresh} -> GET /api/users/ with Authorization Bearer -> Receive 200 User[] -> GET /api/roles/ with Authorization Bearer -> Receive 200 Role[]
GET /users/ with authenticated user lacking admin role -> Receive 403 Forbidden -> GET /api/users/ without authentication -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
